title: SonicN
statusNote: Plays: character intro, title, main menu, chapter select and into Neo Green Hill Zone Act 1, where Sonic runs, jumps and attacks.
notes: Menus are confirmed with 5, not with the pad press.
# switches between the letterboxed view and a taller full-screen view. 0 turns the sound on and off.
A soft key pauses; press it again to carry on.

controls.source: Observed in play and in the menus. The title screen and the pause box name the 5 key; the game has no controls screen, and Options > Button Config was left at Normal.
notes: Platformer layout: run on the arrows, jump on X or Space, attack on Z. On a gamepad the standard layout already has 5 and 7 on the face buttons.
